sources.summary: "Inspiration comes from the sky, dwells and descends into the studio, where it takes shape," explains one of the owners of Casa Sombras. This poetic image synthesizes the organization of a home that converts a slope of more than 15 meters into a sequence of contemplation, rest, and creation.
